The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

Regarding the themes in the provided text, both excerpts deal with the concept of aspiration and the human condition, but they differ significantly in tone and outcome. The text on *The Great Gatsby* presents a pessimistic view, emphasizing the "hollowness" of the American Dream and framing Gatsby’s life as tragic. In contrast, the text on *Invisible Man* offers an optimistic perspective, focusing on "self-discovery and affirmation" despite external challenges. While both works explore the struggle of individuals within society, Fitzgerald’s portrayal highlights failure and emptiness, whereas Ellison’s highlights resilience and personal growth.
